name: Student Residence Permit (university-sponsored)

requirements.blocker_text: Admission to and sponsorship by a Qatar-based university -- students cannot self-sponsor a residence permit.
QAR 20,000 bank guarantee (if a sponsor resides in Qatar) or 6 months of bank statements (if the sponsor is abroad), plus health check and police clearance.
requirements.fix_path: Provide the required bank guarantee or bank statements.

evidence_required.document: QAR 20,000 bank guarantee or 6 months bank statements

outcome.duration_length: tied to program length: 5 years (undergraduate/PhD), 3 years (Master's), 1 year (Arabic-for-non-native-speakers track)

sources.title: Qatar University -- prospective-student visa process: university sponsorship, QAR 20,000 bank guarantee or 6-months bank statements, health check, police clearance, permit validity tied to program length

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Qatar).
